record.original_question: Determine whether the ring of functions generated by vincular patterns has algebraic relations beyond the known upgrading relation, and if so describe those additional relations.

evidence.quote: Since this ring contains all linear combinations of vincular patterns, it might be worthwhile to study its algebraic structure further. In particular, it would be interesting to know if there are other relations in this ring.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$, whose elements are written in one-line notation as words $\pi=\pi_1\pi_2\cdots\pi_n$. A vincular pattern of length $k$ is a pair $(\sigma,A)$ where $\sigma\in S_k$ and $A\subseteq\{1,2,\dots,k-1\}$ is a set of "adjacency constraints"; pictorially one writes $\sigma$ with overlines joining consecutive letters $\sigma_i\sigma_{i+1}$ whenever $i\in A$. An occurrence of $(\sigma,A)$ in $\pi\in S_n$ is a sequence of indices $1\le j_1<j_2<\cdots<j_k\le n$ such that
\begin{itemize}
\item the values $\pi_{j_1},\pi_{j_2},\dots,\pi_{j_k}$ are in the same relative order as $\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\dots,\sigma_k$, and
\item $j_{i+1}=j_i+1$ for every $i\in A$.
\end{itemize}
For a vincular pattern $p=(\sigma,A)$ define the function $f_p:\bigsqcup_{n\ge 0}S_n\to\mathbb{Z}$ by letting $f_p(\pi)$ be the number of occurrences of $p$ in $\pi$. Let $\mathcal{R}$ denote the commutative $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra generated, under pointwise addition and multiplication of functions on permutations, by all such functions $f_p$ as $p$ ranges over all vincular patterns of all lengths.

Among the algebraic relations between products of vincular-pattern functions in $\mathcal{R}$ is the so-called "upgrading relation," which expresses, for a vincular pattern $p$ obtained from $p'$ by removing one adjacency constraint at position $i\in A$, the function $f_{p'}$ as a linear combination of $f_p$ and vincular-pattern functions of length one greater obtained by inserting a letter at position $i$.

Question: Does the algebra $\mathcal{R}$ admit any algebraic relations between (products of) vincular-pattern functions other than those that follow from the upgrading relation? If so, give an explicit description of a generating family of such additional relations.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface any follow-up work explicitly resolving the question of whether the ring generated by vincular-pattern functions admits algebraic relations beyond the upgrading relation. No source confirming a complete classification or a counterexample was located, so the current status is unclear.
